    Accidents and Serious Incidents

     

    This accident database contains information dating back to 2001 relative to civil aviation accidents and incidents within the Bahamas and its territorial waters.

     

    Generally, a preliminary report is available online within a few days of an accident.

     

    Factual information is added when available, and when the investigation is completed, the preliminary report is replaced with a final report with a complete description of the accident and its probable cause (if determined).

     

    Full narrative descriptions may not be available for dates before 2001, cases under revision, cases not underlined in the database listing, or where AAIA did not have primary investigative responsibility.

    Incidents and Short Investigations Bulletins

    ​

    The AAIA releases Bulletins of short investigations covering incidents involving jet, turbo-prob, and piston aircraft, helicopters, and remotely piloted aircraft systems when they are reported.

    ​

    The Bulletins also highlight essential safety messages for the broader aviation community, drawing on earlier AAIA investigations and research.

    ​

    The Bulletin provides a summary of the less-complex factual investigation reports conducted by the AAIA. The results, based on information supplied by organizations or individuals involved in the occurrence, detail the facts behind the event, as well as any safety actions undertaken or identified.
